stem: Asha's family celebrates a festival that follows a luni-solar calendar, which adds an extra month every few years. What will Asha notice about this festival's date on the school (Gregorian) calendar?

options.text: It falls on exactly the same Gregorian date every year.
It moves through all the seasons over several years.
It shifts on the Gregorian calendar but stays within the same season.
It is celebrated twice every year without any pattern.

teacher.key_rationale: A luni-solar calendar inserts an intercalary month, so festival dates shift on the Gregorian calendar but the shift is limited, keeping the festival in the same season. A describes a solar (sidereal) festival and B describes a purely lunar festival, both serving as sibling-term traps.
